market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-neutral. Oil above $100 and CPI tick-up create stagflationary pressure. 4th consecutive down day signals momentum shift. Bond selloff and 5% 10-year yield cap equity multiples. Watch for Fed hawkish surprise. Oil volatility dominates near-term risk.
